newsitem.headline: Trigon Healthcare Inc Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: (Dollars in thousands, except per share data)
(Dollars in thousands, except per share data)
NOTE: Proforma results gives effect as if the initial public offering had occurred on January 1, 1995.

Proforma results adjust interest rate for borrowings and an effective tax rate of 35 percent. Proforma earnings per share exclude realized gains, interest expense, the 1996 sale of a subsidiary and extraordinary items.
1996 year and Q4 include $62.3 million gain on sale of a subsidiary.
Q4 periods include $4.5 million in 1996 and $1.7 million in 1995 charges for demutualization costs and Commonwatlth payment.
Q4 net investment income $13.2 million vs $11.0 million.
1995 Q4 includes $371,000 copayment refund program costs.
1995 year includes $47.1 million copayment refund program costs.
Year results include demutualization costs and Commonwealth payments of $190.8 million in 1996 and $4.7 million in 1995.
